blocks.title: Qabil-e-rasai digital mawad
blocks.text: Accessible digital content aisa mawad hai jo is tarah banaya jaye ke maazoor afraad samait har koi use istemal kar sake.

blocks.prompt: Digital mawad accessible kyun hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke nazar, samaat ya doosri maazoori wale log maloomat aur khidmat se bahar na rahein.

items: Accessible mawad maazoor afraad samait sab ke liye kaam karta hai.
